title: Mom and Dad
cn: 第 10 集 · 妈妈和爸爸
novel:
Barney's father, Jerome, [[arrived|arrive]] at the Farhampton Inn for the wedding. Barney had a complicated relationship with his father, who had been [[absent|absent]] for most of his childhood. Seeing Jerome again brought up many [[emotions|emotion]] for Barney.

Barney [[devised|devise]] a [[scheme|scheme]] to get his parents back together. He believed that if he could create the right [[circumstances|circumstance]], his mother Loretta and his father Jerome would [[reunite|reunite]]. He planned a series of [[encounters|encounter]] between them, hoping old feelings would return.

His plan [[involved|involve]] booking them in adjacent hotel rooms and arranging for them to bump into each other at the hotel restaurant. He even [[hired|hire]] a musician to play their favorite song. Loretta and Jerome were [[surprised|surprise]] by the coincidences but did not seem interested in getting back together.

Meanwhile, Ted was [[convinced|convince]] that someone had [[framed|frame]] him. He found embarrassing items in his hotel room that he did not put there. He [[suspected|suspect]] that Barney was playing a trick on him.

Ted [[investigated|investigate]] the matter and discovered that a hotel employee had mistaken his room for someone else's. He felt [[foolish|foolish]] for jumping to conclusions. He [[apologized|apologize]] to Barney for blaming him.

Barney's scheme to reunite his parents ultimately [[failed|fail]]. Loretta told him that she and Jerome were happy with their separate lives. She [[explained|explain]] that sometimes the past should stay in the past. Barney was [[disappointed|disappoint]] but accepted the truth. He realized that what mattered most was the future he was building with Robin.

arrive.en: They arrived at the hotel late.

circumstance.en: Under the circumstances, he did well.

reunite.en: The family reunited after years apart.

convince.en: She convinced him to change his mind.

frame.en: He was framed for the crime.
